I updated the existing pytest suites for the new API (no product code, paginated orders) and added test_revision5.py. Backend: 27/27 passed. rca of the issue: Orders list pagination snapped back to page 1. Cause: Orders.tsx uses useQuery with placeholderData: keepPreviousData, plus the effect `if (data && data.page !== page) setPage(data.page)`. When the user moves to page 2, the query key changes, but `data` still holds the previous response (page 1) as placeholder. The effect then forces page back to 1 before the page-2 response arrives. Reproduction: as admin, open /admin/orders with more than 10 orders and click Berikutnya; the count stays 'Menampilkan 1–10' and the network shows page=2 followed by page=1. Fix: destructure isPlaceholderData and add `!isPlaceholderData` to the effect condition. Verified on desktop and mobile: next, page 3, prev, filters, page size and search all work.
